text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the holidays approach, we're finishing
our
usual training when I tell Curren
Chan I want to
show her something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a little late, but I've bought her a
present for
getting first place in the
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Reservations for Visee Noir's limited
holiday
dinner course?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's totally amazing! This restaurant is
super
famous!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's all over Umastagram every winter.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's so hard to get reservations here! How
did you
manage this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spent a long time researching trends on

Umastagram and then used Director
Akikawa's
connections to get the
reservations.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You really thought hard about this for
me.
Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You really thought hard about this for
me.
Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan seems happy. The
reservation is for
multiple people, so I
thought she could bring her
roommate,
Admire Vega, or some other friends.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...My friends?
choice_data_list: Go have fun with your friends!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Not you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Not you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm not going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's unusual for Curren Chan to refuse
something
so vehemently...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And don't get me wrong, I'm really
grateful.
Thank you for being so
thoughtful and doing
something like this
for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... this isn't what would make me
happiest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Deep down, you know that, don't you? Don't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And here I thought adults were supposed to be smart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And here I thought adults were supposed to be smart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...In any case, I can't accept this gift. Not
now,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They don't expire for a while, so wait
until I'm
more of a smart adult too, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Instead...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to celebrate the holidays a
few days
later. When the day comes...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro! This way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! This way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They're selling seasonal cakes over
there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I really want one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Curren Chan's request, we walk
through the
town decorated with lights.
But...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Why wouldn't it be? We're celebrating the holidays with a date! I think this is more than enough of a present.
choice_data_list: Are you really sure this is enough?
Are you really sure this is enough?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Although, I suppose it's okay that you
keep
thinking of this as just another
hangout.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Although, I suppose it's okay that you
keep
thinking of this as just another
hangout.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be a kid for a little bit longer
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Soooo!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't treat me too much like an adult
yet. I still
want you to spoil me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan spends the rest of
the night
making me spoil her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What a beautiful view! Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our normal training, Curren Chan
asks me to
walk up a hill with her to see
the nighttime
cityscape.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...The view at night really gets you
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's someone on the other end of
every single
one of those lights...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And some of them don't even know who
I am yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop until all of the lights in the
world shine
with cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what "shine with cuteness"
means...
but even on the holidays, she's
thinking about her
goals.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... I've got a long way to go before
that. I
mean, I'm still pushing you around
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... I've got a long way to go before
that. I
mean, I'm still pushing you around
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Like... with the holiday reservations you
gave me.
Sorry for rejecting them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You put a lot of thought into that gift,
and I was
really happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... I still think you messed up on the
details.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You mean you're not mad?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
choice_data_list: Having you be stubborn with me is a privilege, though.
Having you be stubborn with me is a privilege, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I really do have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You made my heart skip a beat for a
second
there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You made my heart skip a beat for a
second
there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna master cuteness and become
an even
more wonderful me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think that's good for this year. I
love all
the time I get to spend talking
to you. But, you
know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think that's good for this year. I
love all
the time I get to spend talking
to you. But, you
know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm the kind of girl who gets whatever
she wants,
right? So next year...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you say you wanna
spend the
holidays with me too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Pft.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe. Just you wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe. Just you wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stay put a little while longer, looking
at the
stars and talking endlessly to each
other.
